skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target with 2 consecutive strikes and triggers a [Combo].

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 5 consecutive strikes, dealing 300% ATK DMG. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] on 3 random targets and triggers a [Combo]. [Internal Injury]: When the affected target is attacked, it takes [Internal Injury] DMG equal to 200% of Silverfang’s ATK. The effect disappears after triggering.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 5 consecutive strikes, dealing 350% ATK DMG. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] on all targets and triggers a [Combo]. [Internal Injury]: When the affected target is attacked, it takes [Internal Injury] DMG equal to 250% of Silverfang’s ATK. The effect disappears after triggering.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: During the first 2 rounds, after taking an action, removes the enemy team’s sealed Energy, up to once per round. After sealed Energy is successfully removed, [Fear] cannot be inflicted on enemies during the same round. At battle start, permanently gains 30% [Instant DMG Evasion]. Permanently increases own HP by. [Instant DMG Evasion]: Direct DMG, Extra DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG only deal 1 point of DMG.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: During the first 3 rounds, after taking an action, reduces the enemy team’s Energy while [Fear] is active, up to once per round. At battle start, permanently gains 40% [Instant DMG Evasion]. Permanently increases own HP by. [Instant DMG Evasion]: Direct DMG, Extra DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG only deal 1 point of DMG.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: When Silverfang attacks, Bomb uses the same type of skill to perform a [Combo] against enemy targets. Bomb inherits 100% of Silverfang’s ATK. Basic: Deals 100% ATK DMG to 1 random target. Ultimate: Attacks all enemies with 3 consecutive strikes, dealing 180% ATK DMG.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: When Silverfang attacks, Bomb uses the same type of skill to perform a [Combo] against enemy targets. Bomb inherits 100% of Silverfang’s ATK. Basic: Deals 100% ATK DMG to 1 random target. Ultimate: Attacks all enemies with 3 consecutive strikes, dealing 210% ATK DMG. When Bomb performs an Ultimate [Combo], reduces the enemy team’s Fighting Spirit by 250 for each target affected by [Internal Injury].

effects.desc: Causes Bomb to perform the same type of skill after Silverfang attacks. A Basic [Combo] attacks 1 random target, while an Ultimate [Combo] attacks all enemies with 3 consecutive strikes.
When the affected target is attacked, it takes additional DMG based on Silverfang’s ATK. The effect disappears after triggering.
Reduces Direct DMG, Extra DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG to 1 point of DMG.
An Energy-related negative effect associated with reducing or sealing the enemy team’s Energy.
A battle resource reduced by 250 for each enemy affected by [Internal Injury] when Bomb performs an Ultimate [Combo].
